artists.source_line: The trip is organised by Dilson Kizomba and his team, in collaboration with The American Schools of Angola. Dilson is a world-renowned dancer, teacher, and choreographer, as well as the leader and artistic director of the Kotas Que Bailam group. He has extensive experience bringing international guests to Angola for cultural trips.
